normative_extracts.quote: The anchor() function resolves to a length representing the position of a specified edge of the anchor element, evaluated during layout.

browser_support.notes: Supported in Chromium 125+ and Safari 26; use Floating UI or a polyfill where Firefox support is required.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Engine lays out the anchor first, resolves anchor() insets on the positioned element, and tries position-try-fallbacks if it overflows the containing block.

production_failures.symptom: Tooltip ignores anchor-name and pins to the viewport corner (0, 0)
production_failures.root_cause: An ancestor between the anchor and tooltip has contain: layout or overflow/transform hiding the anchor name scope.
production_failures.mitigation: Ensure anchor-scope is not blocking visibility, or place the tooltip in the Top Layer via [popover] where anchor lookup spans the document.

production_failures.symptom: Tooltip clips off-screen near the bottom of the viewport
production_failures.root_cause: position-area or anchor() was set without position-try-fallbacks: flip-block.
production_failures.mitigation: Add position-try-fallbacks: flip-block, flip-inline so the layout engine flips the tooltip automatically.
